title: Vesuvius
tagline: We're creating a decentralized data labelling service that allows for creating rich data for AI, faster and cheaper
description: We're solving the coordination problem between data labelers and data owners but creating peer to peer encrypted services for data annotations. We're facing an overwhelming infrastructure shortage, where there's a great need for well annotated and high fidelity data label services. We realize that a lot of these services in Web2 that control the price of data labelling, and we want to change that.
how_its_made: We use XMTP for peer to peer communication, Airstack for queries and Lens Protocol for seeking valuable data. The Data Labeller submits a dataset to Vesuvius. The smart contract function randomly assigns 3-10 labellers to label each datapoint. Then once the labels sent by each labeler, and a majority is reached, the payment associated with that datapoint is disbursed equally to all labelers who agree.
